integrity: Exact definitions, proofs, structural boundaries, verification code and limitations included. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to labelled star graphs K_{1,m} with m>=2; rarity asymptotics hold as m tends to infinity. Exhaustive checks cover m=1..5 and do not replace the proof. Previously implicit or unindexed star-family formulas cannot be ruled out.
title: Almost-everywhere regularity in Margolis–Rhodes monoids of star graphs
